Author: naco-ff14
Name: AltMate
Punchline: Multi-character linking, housing, animation, and gil tools
Description: AltMate supports multiple FFXIV clients running on the same PC. It provides automatic follow and multi-seat mount assistance, combat and travel synchronization, housing lottery/open-plot tracking, Penumbra emote playback, and shared gil summaries. Data and control messages stay on the local PC. The interface supports Japanese and English.
